description: Train Station Entrance Locations is a dataset listed in Transport for NSW Open Data Hub (opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Open Data Hub. This dataset contains a list of every entrance for every station in NSW. The data includes street name, street type, entrance type, location (latitude and longitude) of the entrance and exit number (if applicable). Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Open Data Hub. Its tags are NSW Trains, Sydney Trains, opendata. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-08-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tfnsw-open-data-hub.
